2f90fed959.en: LLMs dominate, but the focus is reliability — citations, symbolic reasoning, grounding and rationality limits — alongside multimodal foundation models in medicine, physics-informed generative simulation, and interpretable autonomous-driving AI.

d652e76ba0.en: Chain-of-Thought Improves Text Generation with Citations in LLMs
d652e76ba0.zh: Chain-of-Thought Improves Text Generation with Citations in LLMs

b6c91062da.en: Enable LLMs to generate text with accurate citations, improving answer correctness and citation quality.
b6c91062da.zh: 让大语言模型生成带有准确引用的文本，提升答案的正确性和引用质量。

a2fd80b12b.en: LLMs hallucinate and struggle to synthesize and properly cite across multiple documents.
a2fd80b12b.zh: 大语言模型会产生幻觉，难以综合多篇文档并正确引用。

53b4a4abe9.en: Chain-of-Thought prompting to synthesize answers with citations
53b4a4abe9.zh: 用 Chain-of-Thought 提示词综合答案并附上引用

5868b10f31.en: Four prompting strategies: Vanilla, Summ, Snippet, Oracle

4994e50619.en: A Citation Insurance Mechanism (CIM) detects and fixes missing citations (LLM- and IR-based)
4994e50619.zh: 引用保险机制（CIM）检测并修复缺失的引用（基于大语言模型和基于 IR）

b93502c4fe.en: Combines CoT reasoning with a citation-insurance mechanism to guarantee citations.
b93502c4fe.zh: 将 CoT 推理与引用保险机制结合，保证引用的完整。

a8d6023a36.en: Consistent gains in citation recall/precision, correctness and fluency on ALCE across six LLMs (13–70B).
a8d6023a36.zh: 在 ALCE 上，六个大语言模型（13–70B）的引用召回率/精确率、正确性和流畅度均持续提升。

cfbc45e558.en: Chain-of-Thought prompting with a Citation Insurance Mechanism for citeable LLM answers.
cfbc45e558.zh: Chain-of-Thought 提示词加引用保险机制，让大语言模型的答案可引用。

90f02d60ee.en: Can LLMs Serve as Rational Players in Game Theory?
90f02d60ee.zh: Can LLMs Serve as Rational Players in Game Theory?

ddb2c513c2.zh: {1}大语言模型作为理性参与者{/1} · AAAI 2024

90390449ba.en: Assess whether LLMs can act as rational players in social-science game experiments.
90390449ba.zh: 评估大语言模型能否在社会科学博弈实验中扮演理性参与者。

268a8e58f6.en: Rationality requires building desires, refining beliefs under uncertainty, and taking optimal actions.
268a8e58f6.zh: 理性要求形成欲望、在不确定性下修正信念，并采取最优行动。

51d8bf826f.en: Three classic games: dictator, rock-paper-scissors, ring-network
51d8bf826f.zh: 三个经典博弈：独裁者博弈、石头剪刀布、环形网络博弈

51bf564ac5.en: Evaluate desire, belief refinement and optimal action
51bf564ac5.zh: 评估欲望、信念修正和最优行动

d4569318e3.en: Systematic analysis across LLMs including GPT-4
d4569318e3.zh: 对包括 GPT-4 在内的多个大语言模型进行系统分析

4b472def1a.en: A systematic framework for probing the rationality boundaries of LLMs in game theory.
4b472def1a.zh: 一个用于探查大语言模型在博弈论中理性边界的系统框架。

147ca3b70a.en: LLMs show basic desire but struggle with belief refinement; GPT-4 is sometimes human-like — guidance for social-science use.
147ca3b70a.zh: 大语言模型具备基本的欲望，但在信念修正上表现不佳；GPT-4 有时接近人类，为社会科学应用提供参考。

70f1732800.en: Probing LLM rationality across the dictator, rock-paper-scissors and ring-network games.
70f1732800.zh: 在独裁者博弈、石头剪刀布和环形网络博弈中探查大语言模型的理性。

030e8ebb60.en: Frugal LMs Trained to Invoke Symbolic Solvers (SYRELM)
030e8ebb60.zh: Frugal LMs Trained to Invoke Symbolic Solvers (SYRELM)

0dd3bd9435.en: Achieve parameter-efficient, interpretable arithmetic reasoning without massive LLMs.
0dd3bd9435.zh: 不依赖超大规模大语言模型，实现参数高效、可解释的算术推理。

e23fcee7a4.en: LLMs are resource-intensive and unreliable for arithmetic reasoning.
e23fcee7a4.zh: 大语言模型资源消耗大，且在算术推理上不可靠。

615943246f.en: Translate natural-language questions into formal language (e.g. Python) for a symbolic solver
615943246f.zh: 将自然语言问题翻译成形式语言（如 Python），交给符号求解器处理

9303dd7ccf.en: Fine-tune a small LM with a Low-Rank Adapter (LoRA)
9303dd7ccf.zh: 用低秩适配器（LoRA）微调一个小型语言模型

ef2014875c.en: Optimize with PPO using a reasoning-specific reward (compilation, variable/operator match, answer error)
ef2014875c.zh: 用 PPO 优化，使用针对推理的奖励（编译、变量/运算符匹配、答案误差）

8352352938.en: A frugal LM + symbolic solver, with middle-school-math pedagogy shaping the reward.
8352352938.zh: 节俭的语言模型加符号求解器，并以初中数学教学法来设计奖励。

51b1a8b584.en: Strong arithmetic gains with a small, accessible, interpretable alternative to huge LLMs.
51b1a8b584.zh: 算术能力显著提升，是大型语言模型之外小巧、易获取、可解释的替代方案。

a49633e9b5.en: SYRELM translates questions to formal language for a symbolic solver (LoRA + PPO).
a49633e9b5.zh: SYRELM 将问题翻译成形式语言交给符号求解器（LoRA + PPO）。

0021530152.en: PromptGAT: Sim-to-Real Transfer for Traffic Signal Control with Prompt Learning
0021530152.zh: PromptGAT: Sim-to-Real Transfer for Traffic Signal Control with Prompt Learning

14dcd421bf.en: Close the sim-to-real gap for reinforcement-learning traffic signal control.
14dcd421bf.zh: 缩小强化学习交通信号控制中的仿真到现实差距。

87dbc8b62d.en: Grounded Action Transformation (GAT) struggles with unobserved states; prompt learning was untried for sim-to-real.
87dbc8b62d.zh: Grounded Action Transformation (GAT) 难以处理未观测到的状态；提示词学习尚未用于仿真到现实迁移。

8b81a060d0.en: Use LLMs to improve GAT's forward (dynamics) model
8b81a060d0.zh: 用大语言模型改进 GAT 的前向（动力学）模型

df90e8943e.en: Prompt-based grounded action transformation aligns policy with realistic dynamics
df90e8943e.zh: 基于提示词的 grounded action transformation 使策略与真实动力学对齐

d23ab9f194.zh: 在四个交通信号控制场景中评估

4478f91d8f.en: First to bring prompt learning (LLMs) into sim-to-real grounded action transformation.
4478f91d8f.zh: 首次将提示词学习（大语言模型）引入仿真到现实的 grounded action transformation。

e37052feb9.en: Mitigates the RL sim-to-real performance gap for urban traffic control.
e37052feb9.zh: 缓解城市交通控制中强化学习的仿真到现实性能差距。

9ec876751d.en: PromptGAT — LLM-improved grounded action transformation for sim-to-real traffic control.
9ec876751d.zh: PromptGAT：用大语言模型改进 grounded action transformation，用于仿真到现实的交通控制。

d169e248f3.en: Building Conversational Artifacts for APIs and RPAs
d169e248f3.zh: Building Conversational Artifacts for APIs and RPAs

53ee1f630d.en: Make API/RPA automation usable by non-technical users via conversational digital assistants.
53ee1f630d.zh: 通过对话式数字助手，让非技术用户也能使用 API/RPA 自动化。

97b8598eea.en: Domain knowledge and LLM fine-tuning are costly (esp. for SMEs); LLMs at runtime risk trust and indemnity.
97b8598eea.zh: 领域知识和大语言模型微调成本高（尤其对中小企业）；在运行时使用大语言模型会带来信任和赔偿责任风险。

776ff0f29d.en: Human-guided authoring of API services as chatbot skills
776ff0f29d.zh: 由人引导，把 API 服务编写成聊天机器人技能

a7406d49a8.en: LLMs used only in the build phase — pre-generate and review conversational artifacts
a7406d49a8.zh: 仅在构建阶段使用大语言模型：预先生成并审核对话式工件

bf1a8d76ef.en: Intent classification, question generation and Next-Best-Agent via ChromaDB + MiniLM
bf1a8d76ef.zh: 通过 ChromaDB + MiniLM 实现意图分类、问题生成和 Next-Best-Agent

24dab30c06.en: Pre-generated, reviewed artifacts remove LLMs from user interactions entirely.
24dab30c06.zh: 预先生成并经过审核的工件，使用户交互中完全不再需要大语言模型。

c4ba39b6af.en: Lower build effort, trustworthy automation and an automated DevOps deployment pipeline.
c4ba39b6af.zh: 更低的构建成本、可信的自动化，以及自动化的 DevOps 部署流水线。

dc65f8b201.en: Pre-generated conversational artifacts turn APIs / RPAs into chatbot skills.
dc65f8b201.zh: 预先生成的对话式工件把 API / RPA 变成聊天机器人技能。

5fa3ba3d74.en: PathAsst: A Generative Foundation AI Assistant for Pathology
5fa3ba3d74.zh: PathAsst: A Generative Foundation AI Assistant for Pathology

00606a5e96.en: Build a multimodal generative foundation assistant for diagnostic and predictive pathology.
00606a5e96.zh: 构建面向诊断和预测病理的多模态生成式基础助手。

f41dc239c5.en: Pathology multimodal models are limited by scarce tailored data and model frameworks.
f41dc239c5.zh: 病理多模态模型受限于缺乏针对性的数据和模型框架。

dbc6ea2dfe.en: Collect 207K pathology image-text pairs + 180K ChatGPT instruction samples (PathCap, PathInstruct)
dbc6ea2dfe.zh: 收集 207K 病理图文对 + 180K ChatGPT 指令样本（PathCap、PathInstruct）

f1356d6147.en: Build PathCLIP, a pathology-dedicated CLIP model
f1356d6147.zh: 构建 PathCLIP，一个病理专用的 CLIP 模型

f2c4771fd7.en: Integrate PathCLIP with Vicuna-13B, plus eight pathology-specific sub-models
f2c4771fd7.zh: 将 PathCLIP 与 Vicuna-13B 集成，并加入八个病理专用子模型

a9f4667c1d.en: A pathology-dedicated CLIP + instruction-tuned assistant toward pathology AGI.
a9f4667c1d.zh: 病理专用的 CLIP 加指令微调的助手，迈向病理 AGI。

8d8f2cd6b8.en: Stronger diagnostic and predictive analytics on digitized histopathology.
8d8f2cd6b8.zh: 在数字化组织病理图像上实现更强的诊断和预测分析。

5372cdb4c6.en: PathAsst — PathCLIP + Vicuna-13B, a generative foundation assistant for pathology.
5372cdb4c6.zh: PathAsst：PathCLIP + Vicuna-13B，面向病理的生成式基础助手。

b59feaf45a.zh: Bootstrapping Cognitive Agents with a Large Language Model

884b91dfee.zh: {1}大语言模型引导的认知智能体{/1} · AAAI 2024

111c458a5b.en: Combine LLM common-sense with a cognitive architecture for embodied tasks.
111c458a5b.zh: 将大语言模型的常识与认知架构结合，用于具身任务。

40f2dda358.en: Cognitive architectures need knowledge; LLMs hallucinate and need grounding.
40f2dda358.zh: 认知架构需要知识；大语言模型会产生幻觉，需要落地。

541956a2cc.en: Separate knowledge generation (LLM) from application (cognitive architecture)
541956a2cc.zh: 将知识生成（大语言模型）与知识应用（认知架构）分离

587c30bb0d.en: Generate English action descriptions → executable Python production rules; a critic LLM improves them
587c30bb0d.zh: 生成英文动作描述 → 可执行的 Python 产生式规则；由一个评审大语言模型加以改进

231442dcbb.en: Production reinforcement updates utilities; evaluate in AI2THOR kitchens (find / slice / clear)
231442dcbb.zh: 产生式强化更新效用值；在 AI2THOR 厨房中评估（查找 / 切 / 清理）

3689f185b8.en: A modular LLM + cognitive-architecture bootstrap that curbs hallucination and generalizes.
3689f185b8.zh: 模块化的大语言模型 + 认知架构引导方式，可抑制幻觉并具备泛化能力。

5d181555da.en: More efficient, adaptable embodied agents that need minimal LLM help at runtime.
5d181555da.zh: 更高效、适应性更强的具身智能体，运行时只需极少的大语言模型协助。

f16b7c1461.en: Bootstrapping a cognitive agent with an LLM that generates and refines production rules.
f16b7c1461.zh: 用大语言模型生成并优化产生式规则，引导认知智能体。

ae793593b6.en: KG-TREAT: Treatment Effect Estimation by Synergizing Patient Data with Knowledge Graphs
ae793593b6.zh: KG-TREAT: Treatment Effect Estimation by Synergizing Patient Data with Knowledge Graphs

ffb1ef357e.en: Improve treatment-effect estimation (TEE) by combining patient data with biomedical knowledge graphs.
ffb1ef357e.zh: 结合患者数据与生物医学知识图谱，改进治疗效应估计（TEE）。

389888fab9.en: Small labeled data and sparse, high-dimensional records; full KGs add noise and miss causal links.
389888fab9.zh: 标注数据少，记录稀疏且维度高；完整的知识图谱会引入噪声，并遗漏因果联系。

ee8e3e1dcd.zh: 双焦点个性化知识图谱（治疗-协变量和结果-协变量）

915167d63b.en: Deep bi-level attention synergy (DIVE) across covariates, treatments and outcomes
915167d63b.zh: 跨协变量、治疗和结果的深度双层注意力协同（DIVE）

513523ced5.en: Pre-train with masked-code + link prediction, then fine-tune for TEE
513523ced5.zh: 用掩码编码 + 链接预测进行预训练，再针对 TEE 微调

d92f6c1ff7.en: Dual-focus PKGs + bi-level attention deeply fuse patient data and knowledge graphs.
d92f6c1ff7.zh: 双焦点 PKG + 双层注意力，深度融合患者数据与知识图谱。

9e7085a1a7.en:
Insights

  • LLMs dominate AAAI 2024, but the theme is reliability — citations (CoT + CIM), symbolic solvers (SYRELM), grounding (cognitive agents) and probing rationality limits.
  • Foundation / multimodal models reach high-stakes domains — pathology (PathAsst) and healthcare treatment effects with knowledge graphs (KG-TREAT).
  • Physics- and structure-informed generative models (SPDiff, Vampire, Waabi) bring realism and verifiability to simulation and autonomous driving.

Vision

  • Interpretable, verifiable foundation models (Urtasun / Waabi) over black boxes.
  • Hybrid neuro-symbolic and LLM + cognitive-architecture systems that curb hallucination.
  • Efficiency and robustness: frugal LMs, neuromorphic SNNs and OOD-robust GNNs.

Implications for us

  • Pair LLMs with retrieval, symbolic solvers and knowledge graphs for trustworthy, citeable outputs.
  • Use generative simulation and digital twins to cut real-world data and testing cost.
  • Invest in domain-adapted foundation models and OOD / robustness for deployment.
9e7085a1a7.zh:
洞察

  • 大语言模型主导了 AAAI 2024，但主题是可靠性：引用（CoT + CIM）、符号求解器（SYRELM）、落地（认知智能体）以及探查理性边界。
  • 基础模型 / 多模态模型进入高风险领域：病理（PathAsst），以及结合知识图谱的医疗治疗效应估计（KG-TREAT）。
  • 融入物理与结构知识的生成模型（SPDiff、Vampire、Waabi）为仿真和自动驾驶带来真实性和可验证性。

愿景

  • 可解释、可验证的基础模型（Urtasun / Waabi），而非黑箱。
  • 神经符号混合系统，以及大语言模型 + 认知架构系统，抑制幻觉。
  • 效率与鲁棒性：节俭的语言模型、神经形态 SNN 和抗分布外的 GNN。

对我们的启示

  • 将大语言模型与检索、符号求解器和知识图谱结合，得到可信、可引用的输出。
  • 用生成式仿真和数字孪生，降低真实世界的数据和测试成本。
  • 投入领域适配的基础模型，以及面向部署的分布外泛化 / 鲁棒性。
